scenes.title: Good Birth
scenes.summary: Good birth makes men fonder of honor and contemptuous even of men equal to their ancestors. To be well-born is the excellence of one's stock, to be true to one's birth is not to fall away from one's nature, and great families degenerate, as the descendants of Alcibiades and Dionysius, of Cimon, Pericles and Socrates show.
